goal: Create a network scanning tool that can discover devices and their open ports
acceptance_criteria: Implement scan_port function to check if a port is open on a given host
Implement resolve_host function to resolve IP addresses from hostnames
Implement scan_network function to scan a range of hosts for open ports
Support CIDR notation in host specification
Handle socket cleanup properly to avoid ResourceWarnings
Proper input validation for ports and hosts
JSON output format for easy parsing
Comprehensive error handling for socket operations
Detailed logging for debugging and progress tracking
